signal.secure_allied: Secure, with allied or trusted supply in the delivery
signal.high_fence_untrusted: High fence with few trusted alternatives

anchor.adjacent_stage_share: a strong position in the next step up the chain

aid_status.other_stage: aid recorded at other steps only
aid_status.none: no energy, industry or mining aid recorded for the pair
aid_status.not_reporting: the donor does not report purpose-coded aid to the CRS

aid_gap.aligned: Existing aid already at the step
aid_gap.no_support: Strategic partnership with no current aid
aid_gap.no_aib: Aid with no partnership in this analysis
aid_gap.graduate: Commercially mature: graduate from aid to investment and finance
aid_gap.proxy: Recycling aid cannot be identified in the CRS (proxy only)
aid_gap.stage_wide: Stage-wide aid only: the technology is not identified
aid_gap.stage_wide_commercial: Commercially mature, with stage-wide aid only

constraint.no_capacity: no operating or committed plant in the capacity data
constraint.small_capacity: operating or committed plant below the capacity bar
constraint.know_how: related industrial know-how outside the top quarter
constraint.input_costs: input costs outside the cheapest quarter
constraint.trade_only: a position that rests on trade or output shares, not on plant capacity

benefit_donor.secure_allied: trusted supply of a High-fence input
benefit_donor.high_fence_untrusted: an alternative to concentrated, untrusted supply
benefit_donor.high_need: diversified supply for a high-need step
benefit_donor.aib_shortfall: allied capacity where allied supply falls short
benefit_donor.build: new allied capacity where the AIB finds a gap

benefit_recipient.Extraction: a better-governed resource sector, with skills, infrastructure and a path to local processing
benefit_recipient.Refining: processing capacity at home, with the skills, standards and value capture of a refinery
benefit_recipient.Components: a certified supplier base and export sales of components
benefit_recipient.Assembly: factory capacity, skills and export sales of finished equipment
benefit_recipient.Recovery: a recycling industry and the materials it recovers

fail.income: not development eligible (high income or unclassified)
fail.catch_up: the step is not Catch Up
fail.thin_anchor: a thin anchor (corroborated by context signals only)
fail.capability: capability unverified (the anchor measures another product than the need)

unobserved.no_capacity: plant capacity not covered by the data
unobserved.not_operating: plant capacity not covered by the data
unobserved.know_how: related know-how not covered by the data
unobserved.input_costs: input costs not covered by the data
unobserved.trade_only: plant capacity not covered by the data
